defect: a published receipt quoted a 40-hex coordinate for its own earlier revision that is not a git object: it was the bare sha1 of the file's bytes, transcribed from a console line
correction_ships_in: ord0342_receipt_r4.json, whose every coordinate is produced by git ls-tree / git rev-parse inside the run
why_the_wrong_one_matters: a reader who tried to cat-file it would get nothing, which is exactly the failure the ledger's coordinate gate exists to stop
rule_fitted_after: published_blob() looks a coordinate up in this run's own read-back of refs/heads/commander/control, and the delivery script refuses to publish a path whose bytes differ from what is already there
old_files_untouched: r1, r2, r3 and coordinate_erratum_r1 stay published, byte-identical, not deleted
